notes:
Close overlapping Tatami outlines with Enter, in either drawing direction.

- Finish a Tatami outline with its endpoints apart. StitchFits supplies the closing edge and automatically finds a safe internal join for a two-section overlap.
- The section containing the first drawing node stitches underneath. Properties > Self overlap > Reverse order swaps the layers. Keep one editable object and switch between Tatami and closed Satin.
- Reshaping an existing fill into a supported overlap now finds the join automatically instead of stopping the node movement.
- Preserves the letter counter, authored nodes and curves, underlay settings, and both overlapping cover layers. All underlay sews before either top layer.
- Clearer feedback when an outline cannot be resolved safely. Draft nodes are kept on failure.

Verified offline with Enter-key regression tests, both drawing directions, different authored starts, a curved 35-node letter, small dense outlines, holes, saving, undo/redo, and saved Tatami/Satin letter geometry. Physical stitch-out testing is not included. Automatic overlap currently supports one seam with two valid sections.
